description: Aggregated rank-tracking summary for a project over a date window: average and best positions, trends, share of voice (own and per competitor), sentiment split, mention/SERP/shopping rates, and position-distribution buckets. This is the project overview; prefer it before the per-cluster or time-series tools. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "how visible is my brand", "am I ahead of competitors", "how positive is my coverage".

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

name: get_project_rank_tracking_stats
title: Project rank-tracking overview
